text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Outside the family restaurant. Fair 
banners were fluttering in the breeze. 
Could that be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is... a dream, right? What 
do the words on that flag look like to 
you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This isn't a dream!? Who on earth 
concocted such a sinful food fair?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, the sweet aroma of marron cream is 
drifting all the way over here... And 
right at 3 PM, when a maiden's heart is at 
its most vulnerable..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I have no means to resist such temptation.
choice_data_list:
Since we're here, let's go. I'll come with 
you.

Since we have the chance, shall we go? 
I'll come along too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so much. If you had told me 
to go alone, I honestly wouldn't have 
trusted myself to show any restraint..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"So, what shall we do? With this alluring 
slope that could easily be called 
Nakayama's hill."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
May I sprint up the slope with all my 
might?
choice_data_list: Let's eat to our hearts' content.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*, y-yes, of course... A Mont Blanc 
should always be savored with elegance."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall keep it in moderation. I had 
already thought as much myself. It is only 
natural, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...You're so mean, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing. Let us proceed that way, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Whew, thank goodness. My self-restraint 
kicked in after satisfying my palate with 
just that first one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us avoid approaching this shop for a 
while. Better safe than sorry, as they 
say.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I held her back from overeating. As a 
result, the moderate amount of sugar 
seemed to have sharpened her mind a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"So that is your order! Never have I found 
you so radiant, and yet so utterly 
detestable."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very well, my resolve is set. Let us go. 
To see the view beyond that hill.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*burp*... What a wonderful yet lamentable 
experience. This sense of fulfillment and 
guilt...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh, creak? Trainer, did you just say 
'creak'?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, of course. No matter how much I may 
have overeaten, for the asphalt to squeak 
like that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall burn off everything I ate through 
training. Now then, let us devote 
ourselves wholeheartedly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up spoiling her. But it seems her 
potential has expanded just as much as the 
calories she took in.
